title: Midpoint logarithmic inequality
statement: For nonnegative real numbers $a$ and $b$, twice their arithmetic mean multiplied by the base-$2$ logarithm of the reciprocal of their arithmetic mean is at most the sum of $a$ times the base-$2$ logarithm of $1/a$, $b$ times the base-$2$ logarithm of $1/b$, and $|a-b|$.
